source.evidence: Exact source revision and generated CAD exports are pinned in assets/preflight/MODEL_SOURCE_REVISION.md; geometry values are CAD-derived design dimensions, not a metrology certificate.

coordinate_frame.y_axis: airframe longitudinal; camera/front is negative Y
coordinate_frame.simulator_frame: right-handed ENU world frame; X/Y horizontal, Z up
coordinate_frame.body_forward: positive body X; CAD nose is negative Y
coordinate_frame.body_left: positive body Y; CAD positive X
coordinate_frame.spin_sign_semantics: spin_sign is the sign of body reaction torque about +body Z; rotor angular momentum uses the opposite sign
coordinate_frame.units: metres internally; source CAD parameters are millimetres

geometry.ground_clearance_reference: CAD-derived from minimum assembled Z=-5.9737 mm in output/smooth2-parametric/validation-report.json; clearance is recomputed relative to each episode CG
geometry.ground_contact_points_reference: Conservative underside support samples from body_lower and four arm CAD bounding boxes in CAD_EXPORT_Z_UP; a collision proxy, not exact tessellated contact geometry.

notes: Rotor locations are derived from the latest 3D/kilo CAD propeller and motor centers using model_scale 1.414028 and the documented 90-degree X export rotation.
The source CAD defines four-blade propellers with a final diameter of approximately 159.0 mm and nominal geometric pitch 98.004 mm.
Simulator thrust-generation code and its configured thrust coefficient are intentionally unchanged by this CAD synchronization; CAD-derived BEMT estimates are not measured thrust data.
Mass and inertia values remain unknown and are deliberately null. Geometry synchronization does not create physical mass-property calibration.
Alternating spin signs remain a conventional quad-X assumption and must be confirmed against actual motor wiring and propeller rotation direction.
